provenance.verification_limit: This file preserves the reported result and selected diagnostic values, not independently retrieved raw Windows artifacts.

run.scope: One default chronology test run with passive timing diagnostics

interval_definitions.begin_minus_post_queue_observation: The existing Worker begin sample minus the Control callback's observation after the actual queued store. This is not an exact publication-to-begin interval.
interval_definitions.worker_end_minus_begin_wall: Existing Worker end minus begin wall-clock samples, including scheduling and observation overhead. Not CPU decoding time or necessarily the entire Worker job.
interval_definitions.acceptance_observation_minus_worker_end: Control acceptance observation minus the existing Worker end sample. Not exact acceptance publication time.

timing_associations.adjacent_gap_provenance: Values are preserved as the child-reported adjacent Worker gaps. The published inspector exposes per-job begin/end samples but does not itself calculate adjacent-job gaps. This archive does not claim independently retrieved endpoint timestamps.

selected_acceptance_evidence.outcome: typed odd followed by retry accepted
